how.title: A rental process everyone can understand.
how.intro: KEYFORTA is designed around a shared record: the same property, terms, payments, and requests can be understood by the people who are allowed to see them.
steps: Browse clear listings and compare location, price, layout, amenities, and availability.
Review property, authority, and participant verification signals before arranging a viewing.
Request a viewing and keep appointment details in one place.
Review rent, deposit, responsibilities, and documents before signing.
Record payments and receipts so both sides share the same history.
Submit requests, track progress, and preserve communication through move-out.

trust.title: Clarity before commitment.
trust.intro: KEYFORTA is being designed to reduce ambiguity across listings, people, agreements, payments, and maintenance. The signals below are examples of how a connected workflow can communicate what is known and what still needs evidence.
steps: Gather property details, ownership or management authority, identity information, and supporting evidence.
Record who reviewed each item, when it was reviewed, and whether more information is required.
Show participants clear status labels and a safe path to report a concern before money changes hands.
trust.principle_1_body: Rent, deposits, responsibilities, fees, and important dates should be visible before a tenant commits.
trust.principle_2_body: Agreements, receipts, requests, and important communication should be preserved for the appropriate participants.
trust.principle_3_body: A submitted document is not the same as a verified claim. Confirm availability and terms before making a commitment.
trust.stay_safe_body: Never send money based solely on a public listing. Confirm the property, recipient, and written terms through a trusted channel.

faq.title: Answers before you begin.
items: Are these properties available?
Availability must be confirmed with the property manager before making a commitment.
Can I pay rent through this website?
Not yet. No money is currently collected through this website.
How will properties be verified?
The future workflow will collect property details, ownership or management authority, and evidence before displaying a verification status.
Can a landlord list multiple units?
Yes. The planned platform supports properties with one or many units and a dedicated management workspace.
Will KEYFORTA support French?
Yes. The public experience includes an initial French-language mode, with broader translation coverage planned for the connected product.
How are deposits handled?
Deposit rules will be stated clearly in each agreement, including amount, payment, permitted deductions, and final disposition.
Will tenants receive notifications?
The connected product is planned to support viewing updates, payment reminders, maintenance updates, and important account notifications.
Can I report a concern?
Yes. Use the contact page to report a safety concern.
